name: Doubletake
description: Inhabits optical augments and replays a 0.5-second visual clip from 30 seconds ago — forcing the user to see something they looked at but didn't notice.
observed_behavior: Buffers visual input and re-presents frames the user's attention system flagged but conscious awareness dismissed. A forced second look.
story_hooks: Doubletake shows a freelancer the face of someone following them — someone their eyes saw but their brain ignored
